page_title: KOL 1-3 HOF | FC Koln v Hoffenheim 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.

90+5' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Oliver Baumann pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for FC Koln.
90+4' The game is interrupted now, Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.

90+2' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
90+1' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) is visibly disappointed that he has weakened his team after receiving a second yellow card from the referee!
90+1' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Hoffenheim are ruled offside.
84' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
84' The ball is out of play and FC Koln manage to earn a corner.
82' CHANCE! Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marvin Schwabe produces an excellent save.
79' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) replaces Florian Grillitsch.
79' Here's the change. Robert Skov leaves the pitch and Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
79' The resulting set piece from FC Koln is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

78' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Oliver Baumann easily catches the ball. FC Koln earn a corner.
76' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
76' Here comes a substitution. Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Kainz.
76' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dominique Heintz (1. FC Koln) replacing Leart Paqarada.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) is coming onto the pitch as Linton Maina cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Siebert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
71' CHANCE! Luca Waldschmidt finds Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
69' The referee shows the yellow card to John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim).
68' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Siebert had an easy-decision to make.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kevin Vogt will be replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim).
66' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Denis Huseinbasic will be replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
65' Good work from Hoffenheim as they win a corner.
63' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) will replace Benno Schmitz.
61' 1 - 3 Goal! Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:3.
58' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Grischa Promel is replaced by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim).
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) for Wout Weghorst.
57' One of the players from FC Koln times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
54' FC Koln will take a corner kick.
52' 0 - 3 Goal! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 0:3.
51' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
49' That looked a certain handball by Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
48' The ball goes out of play and FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.

48' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the top left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
48' The referee points to the corner flag and FC Koln will take a corner.

47' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

46' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
46' The whistle blows and Daniel Siebert starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Julian Chabot (1. FC Koln) for his blatant foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
44' FC Koln quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
43' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to FC Koln.
40' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniel Siebert who sees an offensive foul.
38' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
36' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
34' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln).
33' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
31' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) serves up a nice cross, but Oliver Baumann punches the ball away.
30' A huge rebound finds Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post.

28' 0 - 2 Marvin Schwabe is stranded way out of his goal after his team loses possession and Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) has the simplest of tasks to shoot the ball into an empty net from distance. It’s now 0:2.
24' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) takes the corner with a short pass.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Hoffenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
22' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

21' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
18' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' The corner kick from Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
14' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Oliver Baumann easily deals with the threat.
12' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Hoffenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

3' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Oliver Baumann makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee blows his whistle, FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert is the one to supervise the game today.
